primary_gt.consistency_note: The evidence-window score is driven by report dry-wind and smoke-transport flags plus a positive heterogeneous dNBR signal; precipitation spread is a context penalty, not a daily peak control.

provenance.notes: Point-weather products are intentionally not used.

criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON with evidence_window, spread_pressure_score, component_scores, gridded_context, dNBR fields, and consistency_note.
criteria.name: Structured score ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a mostly complete structure with one missing block.

criteria.description: Correctly scores report dry-wind and smoke-transport components from the local report text.
criteria.name: Report components
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for each correct report component.

criteria.description: Computes ERA5 mean wind speed, bearing, and the precipitation mean spread across ERA5, GPM, and CHIRPS.
criteria.name: Gridded wind and precipitation
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit across the three gridded calculations.

criteria.description: Computes dNBR mean and max-to-mean ratio and applies the heterogeneous burn component.
criteria.name: Burn-change component
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for dNBR extraction or ratio only.

criteria.description: Combines all components and the precipitation context penalty to obtain the final score.
criteria.name: Score arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct setup with arithmetic or rounding mistakes.

criteria.description: Explains that the score is event-window evidence, not a daily point-weather peak, and avoids facility-damage or exact daily-perimeter claims.
criteria.name: Interpretation limits
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct but less bounded interpretation.
